slides.headline: The insurer can cut its cost ratio by four points in three years by automating claims

items.title: Claims cost 38% of premiums, eight points above peers
items.text: Manual assessment and slow payments drive both cost and leakage.

items.title: Automated assessment works on 70% of motor claims
items.text: Pilot cut handling time from 23 to 6 days with no rise in leakage.

items.title: The platform pays back in 26 months
items.text: €41M investment, €64M a year of savings from 2028.

items.title: The board is asked to approve phase one
items.text: €18M for photo assessment and triage in 2026.

slides.headline: La cadena puede volver a crecer si cierra tiendas pequeñas y abre formato de proximidad

items.title: Las tiendas de menos de 400 m² pierden dinero
items.text: 38 tiendas con resultado negativo por tercer año.

items.title: La proximidad crece al 7% anual
items.text: Los clientes compran más a menudo y con cestas más pequeñas.

items.title: El nuevo formato se paga en tres años
items.text: Piloto en 5 tiendas con ventas un 22% superiores.

slides.headline: Exiting two markets frees €120M for the core business

items.label: Situation
items.title: Five markets, two of them subscale
items.text: Poland and Romania are 9% of revenue and lose money.

items.label: Complication
items.title: Both need €120M of capex to stay competitive
items.text: Returns stay below the cost of capital even after investment.

items.label: Resolution
items.title: Sell both and reinvest at home
items.text: Two buyers have shown interest at 0.8x revenue.

slides.headline: Five findings from the operations review

items.title: Capacity is not the constraint
items.text: Plants run at 71% utilisation.

items.title: Changeovers are
items.text: They take 19% of planned time.

items.title: Quality losses are concentrated
items.text: Two lines cause 64% of scrap.

items.title: Maintenance is reactive
items.text: 78% of hours are unplanned.

items.title: Fixing these adds 9 points of OEE
items.text: Without new equipment.

slides.headline: Resumen: tres decisiones para el consejo

items.title: Aprobar el plan de eficiencia
items.text: Ahorro de 35 M€.

items.title: Lanzar la marca propia
items.text: Margen +2 pp.

items.title: Vender la filial de transporte
items.text: Ingreso de 60 M€.

slides.headline: The programme is on track, but the second wave needs funding by March to keep the 2027 target

items.label: Situation
items.title: Wave one delivered €22M, ahead of plan
items.text: Procurement and energy renegotiations closed early; overtime is down a fifth.

items.label: Complication
items.title: Automation needs €30M of capex with nine-month lead times
items.text: Ordering after March pushes €11M of savings into 2028.

items.label: Resolution
items.title: Release the wave-two budget now
items.text: Keeps the €65M run-rate target for 2027 and pays back in 22 months.

slides.headline: Six reasons the merger creates value

items.title: Complementary footprints
items.text: Overlap in only 3 of 14 regions.

items.title: Procurement scale
items.text: €45M of savings on combined spend.

items.title: Shared platforms
items.text: One ERP and one data centre by 2028.

items.title: Cross-selling
items.text: €30M of revenue synergies.

items.title: Stronger balance sheet
items.text: Leverage falls to 2.1x.

items.title: Retained talent
items.text: Key managers committed for three years.
